lines.text: Many learners say: I will see him at Monday.
Better: I will see him on Monday.
On! I have class on Monday.

data.wrong: I will see him at Monday.
data.right: I will see him on Monday.

native.hook: 周几前面用 on 哦！
native.tip: 中文说“在星期一”，用一个“在”就够了，所以常把 at 用在所有时间前面。英语里星期几前面要用 on。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I will see him at Monday.”😅 中文一个“在”通用，英语星期前用 on：“I will see him on Monday.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I will see him on Monday.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese uses one small word before all times, but English uses on before a day.
en.caption: Do you say “I will see him at Monday.” 😅 English uses on before a day: “I will see him on Monday.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
